title: A bar operation on the double affine Hecke algebra
summary: We construct a bar-type operation for the affine Hecke algebra $\Ha$ attached to a symmetrizable Kac--Moody group. Our main tool is a geometric bimodule defined using the equivariant $K$-theory of a suitable version of the Steinberg variety for this Kac--Moody group. Using elements of this bimodule corresponding to standard and costandard Hodge $D$-modules on the Kashiwara flag variety, we define a bar involution on $\mathcal{H}_{W}^a$ by relating the left and right actions of $\mathcal{H}_{W}^a$ on this bimodule.
